entries.en: to testify, bear witness; to certify, corroborate
cognizance as proof; to know for certain and be able to attest
entries.notes: 知証为罕见组合，依 Testigo 语境及知/証二字本义推断为“确知作凭”。

entries.zh: 証见：眼见为凭、亲见作証；証人
entries.en: eyewitness; ocular testimony, to see and attest

entries.zh: 証见：眼见为凭、亲见作証；証人
entries.en: eyewitness; ocular testimony, to see and attest
to attest, corroborate what one has seen
proof, credential; token or sign of something

entries.zh: 照身：与本人相符的随身凭记；照应自身的表记、証词
entries.en: token bearing on the person; sign or testimony about oneself
entries.notes: 照身组合罕见，依 “testimonio o señal de algo” 推为随身凭记、表明身份之表记。

entries.en: false testimony; to frame someone, trump up a false charge
entries.notes: 汉字作“問架”而音写 cań quie（ka-kiè）与“問”（būn）不合，疑原字为“假”（假架＝诬构）；“架”取构陷、架词义。

entries.zh: 是非：诬妄不实之言；口舌争端
entries.notes: 取诬言、争讼义以合 testimonio falso；“是”字仅声调标注污损（T99），汉字本身可辨。

entries.en: to stir up quarrels, make false accusations; to sow discord
entries.notes: 使是非为使动组合，依 falso testimonio 语境取诬告挑事义；“是”字声调标注污损（T99）。

entries.zh: 乳抱：怀抱婴儿哺乳、哺育
entries.en: to nurse, suckle (a child at the breast); breasts giving milk
entries.notes: 词头 Fetas broeta 为 17 世纪花体 T 之误读（Tetas brotan la leche），乳抱取怀抱哺育义。

entries.zh: 乳蒲：乳房泌乳之络（奶脉、乳腺）
entries.en: milk veins, lactiferous vessels of the breast
entries.notes: 词头 Jetes 无法确识（疑缺损），依 “venas de leche” 与“乳”字锚定释义。
